problems.explain: First the missing side, by the Pythagorean theorem: YZ = √(37² − 12²) = √1225 = 35. From Y, XZ = 12 is opposite, YZ = 35 is adjacent, and XY = 37 is the hypotenuse. tan = opposite/adjacent = 12/35. (35/12 is tan X, from the other angle.) So 12/35.
